name: NEWROC / South West Wireless Merredin Data Centre
developer: North Eastern Wheatbelt Regional Organisation of Councils (NEWROC) / South West Wireless WA (Crisp Wireless)
notes: Re-verified lead: Shire of Merredin agenda described a BBRF-funded project to fabricate and install a data centre in Merredin plus 11 repeater stations across the NEWROC region; Shire of Bruce Rock minutes later stated the Merredin data centre had been built under the NEWROC project. Small regional/telecom facility; no MW disclosed.

name: Merredin Satellite Earth Station (data centre infrastructure)
developer: Telstra International / Inmarsat (built by DCE Electrical)
notes: New method-driven find: DCE Electrical case study describes construction of a greenfield Satellite Earth Station in Merredin with 5x T5 5.5m K-band antenna facility, a data centre and associated infrastructure; Telstra International added a second antenna in Nov 2022 for Inmarsat I-6 F1. Treated as an edge/telecom ground-station data centre; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: SKA-Low Central Processing Facility (Ngurra Maga)
notes: Re-verified and updated: Ngurra Maga, the SKA-Low telescope's central processing facility on Wajarri Yamaji Country (Murchison Radio-astronomy Observatory precinct), was officially opened in June 2026 per the WA Governor's office and SKAO; it houses the on-site supercomputing and signal-processing systems for telescope data. Scientific/astronomical data-processing facility, not commercial colocation; no public MW capacity.

name: Crisp Wireless Mobile Data Centre, Pinjarra-Williams Road
notes: Re-verified lead: Shire of Murray council agenda references a Crisp Wireless mobile data centre / telecommunications installation on Pinjarra-Williams Road. Small edge/telecom data-centre site; no MW capacity disclosed.
